column2: Strategy interface with three final classes; a Map<String, Supplier<Provider>> acts as the provider registry; Optional<String> separates 'no profile' from errors.
Strategies are small classes with the same method; could equally be plain functions in a dict; regex via re.fullmatch for the e-mail rule.
Like next-auth: each provider is a factory returning a config object {id, authorize}; the context only needs the shape (duck typing).
Abstract base + std::unique_ptr strategies in a std::map keyed by id; std::optional<std::string> for authorize(); std::regex for e-mail.
